THE PERSON / CODE, CANVAS & CAMERA

More than
one thing.

Computer Science Engineering Student · Artist · Photographer.
Based in Hyderabad, India.

I'm a third-year Computer Science and Engineering student specializing in Generative AI at K L University in Hyderabad. I build software across the web, computer vision, and applied machine learning.

I'm currently an AI/ML intern at DRDO's Defence Research & Development Laboratory (DRDL). At the Indian Army's 509 Army Base Workshop, I also contributed to a project on RF signal analysis, classification, and monitoring.

My projects range from LilNest, a maternal-health web app, to MotionBeatz, a music player controlled by hand gestures, and a desktop RF analyzer. I co-authored a paper on cognitive digital twins, currently under review at IEEE ICCCMLA 2026, and contributed interactive examples to freeCodeCamp's functional programming curriculum.

Away from code, I make art and take photographs. It’s another way to pay attention, explore ideas, and tell stories. You can find my visual diary at @aakash.reddie.
